samples.surface: Exposed narrow contact-bearing strip along the lower graphics-card PCB edge.
Another exposed portion of the same lower contact strip.

connector.evidence: The right image exposes a narrow gold-colored strip along the sloping lower PCB edge, distinct from the broad card body and shroud.
connector.uncertainty: The strip is only a few pixels wide. Samples estimate its rough visible axis, not mating endpoints. A key notch is not reliably resolved.

samples.surface: Solid upper portion of the dark motherboard PCIe socket housing.
Solid longitudinal housing wall farther down the same partially visible socket.

socket.evidence: A narrow, elongated socket housing is partially visible at the lower right of the motherboard, separate from the illuminated RAM on the left.
socket.uncertainty: The housing is oblique, dark, and cropped by the image boundary; localization is rough. Its internal key is unresolved. Neither these samples nor the connector samples establish clearance or insertion alignment.

next_view: A closer, unobstructed view looking down into the motherboard PCIe housing and facing the card's lower contact edge is needed to resolve both key features and the currently cropped socket extent.
